steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Stir together: **3½ cups flour**, **1 tsp salt**, **1½ Tbsp sugar** and **1 Tbsp yeast**.

steps.title: Add the water
steps.body: Add and stir with wooden spoon until mixed: **1½ cups warm water**.

steps.title: Prepare the pan
steps.body: In the meantime, heat the oven to 350°F and melt **¼–½ cup butter** in a 10×12 pan.

steps.title: Coat the dough
steps.body: Spread dough in the hot pan with your hands and flip to coat with butter on both sides.

steps.title: Season and cut
steps.body: Sprinkle with garlic salt and parmesan, cut, then let rise for 15 minutes.
